basis: Defining hepatic venous occlusion and combined immunodeficiency; pulmonary fibrosis and neurologic injury occur in fewer than 30%.
Carcinoma originates in vaginal epithelium, a reproductive site outside the axes.
Defining congenital facial palsy, eyelid ptosis and velopharyngeal functional failure; pharynx belongs to the pulmonary axis.
PINK1-related Parkinson disease is neurodegenerative; urinary urgency does not establish intrinsic urinary tract damage.
Inherited qualitative von Willebrand factor defect causing impaired haemostasis; bleeding sites are not additional primary organ diseases.
Defined immunodeficiency; supplied data do not establish common direct ocular, gastrointestinal or skin damage. Associated infections and celiac disease are separate diagnoses.
Inherited bronchiectasis directly damages bronchi; elevated sweat chloride alone does not establish an additional metabolic or skin disorder.
TRPC6-related glomerular disease causes proteinuria and progressive kidney damage; hypertension is a separately diagnosed consequence.
Localized haemorrhage around the testis is a reproductive disorder; it does not itself establish a coagulation or blood-cell disease.
Disease of the eustachian tube, part of the middle-ear apparatus.
Fanconi marrow-failure disorder; microphthalmia in 4/11 (~36%) supports ocular involvement. Cafe-au-lait spots are pigmentary; short thumbs occur in 3/11 (~27%).
Diphtheritic conjunctival infection supported by name, synonyms and conjunctivitis ancestors; the definition's reference to colitis appears erroneous.
Inherited HDL/apolipoprotein disorder; coronary atherosclerosis (2/5) is a separate associated disease. Cataract and tendon xanthomas each occur in only 1/5.
Tuberculous infection directly occupies and damages the central nervous system; pulmonary disease is not required for this extrapulmonary concept.
Nonsyndromic X-linked intellectual disability; supplied dysmorphic features do not establish additional organ dysfunction.
Lymphoid malignancy umbrella predominantly encompasses lymphomas and related haematologic cancers; no additional organ is consistently damaged across the group.
Inherited cutaneous pigmentation disorder defined by hyperpigmented and hypopigmented macules.
ALS2-related degeneration of motor neurons; weakness and spasticity reflect neurologic dysfunction rather than primary muscle disease.
Malignant gliomas originate in central nervous system glial tissue.
Broad lymphoid immune-system disorder umbrella; no specific blood-cell, airway or other organ lesion applies consistently across its subtypes.
Cortical perceptual dysfunction prevents recognition or identification of fingers; the fingers themselves are not damaged.
Malignant epithelial-stromal tumour originates in the ovary; reproductive ovarian tissue is outside the axes.
Neurodegenerative ataxia; pes cavus in 8/18 (~44%); mitral valve prolapse annotated 30-79%. Retinal hypermyelination lacks established visual damage; urinary symptoms are neurogenic.
Synchronous carcinomas originate in both breasts, which are outside the organ axes.
Severe MECP2 encephalopathy; frequent apnea and respiratory insufficiency reflect central hypoventilation without established intrinsic lung injury. Reflux is a separate disease.
